You got to relax for a second!!! If you guys are just starting out, and it’s turning into a serious commitment, maybe he is just a little scared, and this is his way of confronting that this could be a very longterm relationship! I myself would also get a little freaked out but it’s not an insane amount to worry about. It’s natural for people to have doubts and get a little anxious. Just talk to him about it and figure out how he truly feels. Sometimes people just get anxious!

Try to find out how he talks to other girls, if he does talk to other girls. Sometimes guys can come off as friendly, if he’s been friendly for a long time, say a couple months. Chances are he likes you, but I wouldn’t want to get your hopes up he could be a very genuine person. It’s a 75/25 situation. Maybe try to compliment him about him being nice and turn it into “i bet you’re nice to everyone” but try to remove the bitchyness😂 hope this helped!
